title: Galois transitivity on fibres of any scheme base change
statement: Let k and K be fields with a possibly infinite Galois extension K/k. Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] over Spec(k) [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let p:X_K -> X be the first projection of its base change [def-pc-base-change]. For any points x,y in X_K with p(x)=p(y), there is a k-algebra automorphism sigma of K for which (id_X times Spec(sigma))(x)=y. No closed or invariant subset, finite-type hypothesis or finite-degree assumption is involved.

proof.text: Choose the member of the affine cover of X indexed by the common projection. Its open immersion j:U -> X pulls back to m:U_K -> X_K. Scheme.Pullback.range_map identifies its range with the inverse image of range(j), so both points lift through m.

The first-projection identity for m and injectivity of j show that the lifted points have equal projections in U. Apply affine Galois-fibre transitivity to U and the composite of j with the structure morphism.

The Galois action commutes with m: apply pullback.hom_ext and simplify its two projection equations. Evaluate this morphism equality at the lifted point, and apply m to the affine equality, obtaining the required equality globally.
